topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I reckon this parcel’s mix-up is just another twist of fate, like a hailstorm flattened just after you've begged Saint Benedict for mercy. They say the last fella, Tom, he moved on to the lowlands, but here’s a box meant for his door. I can only wonder what seeds or tools he might’ve been expecting, now sitting heavy in my hands. The master won’t be pleased if I delay, but it feels wrong, sending it back without a second thought. Maybe I’ll ask the priest what the saints would have me do. It’s a hard thing, being the one who finds what can’t be kept.
